note: Chippewa NF campground on the west shore of Cut Foot Sioux Lake, beside Lake Winnibigoshish, ~20 mi NW of Deer River, in two loops half a mile apart: North Deer (hardwoods, sandy swimming beach) and South Deer (red and white pines, small beach), with a boat ramp between them reaching the lake by Biauswah Creek. North sites 2 and 4 sit in the trees about 40 m from the shore with a filtered lake view. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 231997 read: $16 single / $32 double confirmed, no electric, vault toilets + hand pumps, 48 sites (28 on rec.gov, rest FCFS, 4-day cutoff). Season 05-07..11-24 (FS 5/7-10/31; South open to 11/24/26), booking season 05-07..09-07. Lakeview kept (rec.gov tags 002N/004N 'Lakefront'; photos show a wooded strip).
flags: Waterfront lead (kept lakeview): recreation.gov tags North sites 002N (47.51798,-94.10074) and 004N (47.51766,-94.10081) 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'. On Esri imagery they are ~40 m from the Cut Foot Sioux shore but under continuous hardwood canopy, and the rec.gov photos of both sites show only lake light through a wooded band - a filtered view, not open ground. Other North sites are 60-120 m back; South Deer sites are 150 m+ from open water under pines. Stays lakeview.

Pin 47.5152,-94.1037 is between the two loops (catalog centroid 47.5151,-94.1039; North centroid ~47.5177,-94.1012, South ~47.5137,-94.1052), no move. The loops are ~0.5 km apart on the same road under one name: not a split.
